_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to 0.41.0's merge commit (still a SHA, not a tag -- pine-lang doesn't tag releases): adds a data-driven access policy for restricted evaluation. beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.55.0, which adds named access policies with a hard MCP-always-protected invariant and the 'Only apply to MCP server' toggle.
